info.name: New Registration API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the PG College registration backend (new-reg).

## Setup
1. Import this collection
2. Set `base_url` to your server — default points to production
3. Run **Login** first — the token saves automatically to `{{token}}`
4. All protected routes use `{{token}}` via the collection-level Bearer auth

## Portal Access Flow
Students reach this portal **only after** passing the application portal:
- Admitted + Recommended by admin
- Acceptance fee paid
- Cleared by admissions office

On login the unified `/auth/login` endpoint checks these conditions and routes to either the `registration` or `application` portal.

## Registration Flow
```
1. POST /auth/login  →  portal: "registration", token issued
        ↓
2. GET  /auth/user  →  profile, programme, financial summary
        ↓
3. GET  /clearance  →  read-only admission clearance summary
        ↓
4. GET  /payments/schedule  →  full fee breakdown, total amount, currency
        ↓  (staff with UI employment? Use invoice/verify-staff first)
5. GET  /invoice/preview  →  confirm fees + rebate if applicable
   POST /invoice/generate  →  create school fee invoice (status: initiated)
        ↓  (top up wallet or pay via UnibadanMFB link)
6. GET  /wallet  →  check balance
   POST /wallet/initiate-deposit  →  get UnibadanMFB deposit link
   POST /wallet/pay { invoiceno }  →  pay invoice from wallet
        ↓
7. GET  /courses/available  →  browse courses for dept/degree
   POST /courses/register  →  save course selection
   POST /courses/confirm  →  lock registration
   GET  /courses/print  →  full print data for course form
        ↓
8. GET  /medical  →  fetch/save health record
   POST /medical/passport  →  upload passport photo
        ↓
9. GET  /suspension  →  check/submit suspension application
                        (payment condition enforced — see section 8)
   GET  /reactivation  →  pre-fill for reactivation form printout
                        (requires approved suspension; Records Officer updates status)
        ↓  (programme lapse?)
10. GET  /extension-programme  →  check eligibility + prefill
    POST /extension-programme  →  submit extension request
```

## Staff Rebate Flow
```
1. POST /invoice/verify-staff { pfno }  →  name check + rebate_preview
        ↓  (student prints letter to Provost with rebate_preview amounts)
        ↓  (Provost approves, Finance creates rebate_record in their own admin app)
2. GET  /invoice/preview  →  now includes rebate block if Finance approved it
3. POST /invoice/generate  →  invoice generated at rebated amount
```

## Currency
- Nigerian students: `Naira`
- Foreign students (nationality ≠ Nigeria): `Dollar`

request.description:
Unified portal login. Checks registration conditions first (recommended + acceptance paid + cleared). Falls back to application portal conditions if registration conditions are not met.

**Response (200) — registration portal access:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "portal": "registration",
  "token": "1|abc...",
  "data": {
    "numeration": "PGS26...",
    "surname": "Doe",
    "other_names": "John",
    "email": "john@example.com",
    "telephone": "08012345678"
  }
}
```

**Response (200) — application portal access:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "portal": "application",
  "token": "2|xyz...",
  "data": { ... }
}
```

**Response (401):** Invalid credentials.

**Response (403) — various gates:**
```json
{ "success": false, "message": "...", "gate": "activation|recommendation|acceptance_fee|clearance" }
```

**Response (402) — application fee unpaid:**
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "payment_required": true,
  "gate": "application_fee",
  "data": { "invoiceno": "43781209", "amount": 15000 }
}
```

Looks up account by application number **or** email address. Sends the stored login credentials to the registered email.

**Request:** `identifier` = application number or email.

**Response (200):**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Your login credentials have been sent to your registered email address."
}
```

**Response (404):** No account found.

Returns full student profile, programme, financial summary, admission status, and programme lapse flags.

`degree_type` is derived from the degree name: `higher_degree` for Ph.D / M.Phil, `masters` for all others.

**Response (200):**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "numeration": "PGS26...",
    "surname": "Doe",
    "other_names": "John Michael",
    "email": "john@example.com",
    "telephone": "08012345678",
    "nationality": "Nigerian",
    "session": "2025/2026",
    "programme": {
      "faculty": "Faculty of Science",
      "department": "Computer Science",
      "degree": "M.Sc. Computer Science",
      "degree_type": "masters",
      "mode_of_study": "Full Time",
      "field_of_interest": 3,
      "program_type": null
    },
    "financial_summary": {
      "total_fees": 450000,
      "amount_paid": 200000,
      "outstanding_balance": 250000,
      "percentage_settled": 44,
      "currency": "Naira",
      "invoice_number": "1234567890",
      "invoice_flag": 0
    },
    "admission_status": {
      "recommendation": "Recommended",
      "clearance": "Yes",
      "admitted_semester": 1,
      "supervisor": "Prof. Adeyemi",
      "letter_ready": "Yes",
      "letter_signed": "Yes"
    },
    "lapse_status": {
      "payment_lapse": false,
      "session_lapse": false
    }
  }
}
```

`degree_type` values: `higher_degree` | `masters`

`programme` is `null` if no application record is linked.

## Lapse Status

**`payment_lapse: true`** — The student has at least one prior paid session but has NOT paid for the two most recent consecutive sessions (current session + previous session). The frontend should restrict the student to payment-related endpoints only:
- `GET /payments/schedule`
- `GET /payments/receipts`
- `GET /payments/receipt/{invoiceno}`
- `GET /payments/financial-clearance`
- `GET /payments/financial-clearance/print`
- `GET /payments/records`
- `GET /wallet`
- `POST /wallet/initiate-deposit`
- `POST /wallet/pay`
- `GET /invoice/preview`
- `POST /invoice/generate`
- `GET /invoice`

**`session_lapse: true`** — The student has used up all allowed sessions for their programme (see max sessions table). The frontend should prompt the student to submit a programme extension request via `POST /extension-programme`.

**Max sessions per programme:**
| Programme | Sessions |
|---|---|
| MPhil | 2 |
| Master FT | 3 |
| Master PT | 5 |
| PhD FT | 5 |
| PhD PT | 7 |

An approved suspension adds +1 to the effective maximum.

Revokes the current Bearer token.

**Response (200):**
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "Logged out successfully." }
```

item.name: 3. Payments

request.description:
Returns the complete fee breakdown for the student's programme. If a Finance-approved staff rebate exists, `total_amount` reflects the rebated figure.

**Response (200):**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "session": "2025/2026",
    "faculty": "Faculty of Science",
    "department": "Computer Science",
    "degree": "M.Sc. Computer Science",
    "mode_of_study": "Full Time",
    "type": "New",
    "degree_category": "master",
    "fee_items": [
      { "id": 1, "description": "School Fee", "amount": 350000 },
      { "id": 2, "description": "Development Levy", "amount": 50000 }

    "currency": "Naira"

}
```

`type`: `New` (first registration) | `Renewal` (returning student)

`currency`: `Naira` for Nigerian students | `Dollar` for foreign students

**Response (404):** No programme information found.

**Response (422):** Fee configuration not found for this programme.

**Response (200):**

```json
  "data": {
    "session": "2025/2026",
```

Returns all payment transactions across all fee types (school fees, acceptance, application). Supports optional filters.

**Query params (all optional):**
- `session` — e.g. `2025/2026`
- `fee_type` — `school_fees` | `acceptance` | `application`
- `status` — `paid` | `pending`

**Response (200):**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "total_paid": 515000,
  "transactions": 3,
  "data": [ { ...payment object with fee_type field... } ]
}
```

item.description: All payment endpoints are protected. Fee amounts and currency (Naira / Dollar) are determined automatically from the student's programme and nationality.

item.name: 4. Invoice (School Fees)

request.description:
Verifies a UI staff PF number and checks that the student's full name (Surname + Other_names) exactly matches `staff_list2.name` (case-insensitive, whitespace-normalized).

Returns a `rebate_preview` showing per-item rebated amounts — used by the student to print their letter to the Provost requesting fee rebate.

**This endpoint does NOT write to the database.** Finance creates the rebate record manually after Provost approval via their own admin application. new-reg only reads it.

**Rebate type priority:**
1. Degree name contains "Professional" → `perc_prof`
2. ACADEMIC + staff dept name matches student dept → `percphd_teach_acad_samedept`
3. ACADEMIC + different dept → `percphd_teach_acad_otherdept`
4. NON TEACHING → `perc_nonteach_acad`

The percentage stored in `new_fee` is what the staff **pays** (0 = fully exempt, 100 = full price).

**Response (200):**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "pfno": "UI12345",
    "name": "Adeyemi John Michael",
    "dept": "Computer Science",
    "category": "ACADEMIC",
    "ippis": "123456",
    "student_name": "Adeyemi John Michael",
    "student_appno": "PGS26...",
    "rebate_preview": {
      "rebate_type": "academic_same_dept",
      "total_original": 400000,
      "total_rebated": 80000,
      "items": [
        {
          "id": 1,
          "description": "School Fee",
          "original_amount": 350000,
          "percentage_pays": 20,
          "rebated_amount": 70000
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

`rebate_type` values: `professional` | `academic_same_dept` | `academic_other_dept` | `non_teaching`

**Response (404):** PF number not found.

**Response (422):** Name mismatch — student's full name does not match staff record.

Shows the full fee breakdown before the invoice is generated. If an approved rebate_record exists for this student (created by Finance), the `total_amount` reflects the rebated figure and a `rebate` block is included.

**Response (200) — no rebate:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "student": {
      "name": "Doe John Michael",
      "numeration": "PGS26...",
      "faculty": "Faculty of Science",
      "department": "Computer Science",
      "degree": "M.Sc. Computer Science",
      "mode_of_study": "Full Time",
      "programme": null
    },
    "invoice_session": "2025/2026",
    "degree_category": "master",
    "renewal_type": "new",
    "semester": 1,
    "fee_items": [
      { "id": 1, "description": "School Fee", "amount": 350000 },
      { "id": 2, "description": "Development Levy", "amount": 50000 }
    ],
    "total_amount": 400000,
    "currency": "Naira"
  }
}
```

**Response (200) — with approved rebate:**
```json
{
  "data": {
    ...,
    "total_amount": 80000,
    "rebate": {
      "actual_amount": 400000,
      "rebated_amount": 80000,
      "rebate_type": "academic_same_dept",
      "staff_name": "Adeyemi John",
      "pfno": "UI12345"
    }
  }
}
```

`currency`: `Naira` | `Dollar`

**Response (404):** Programme not found.

**Response (422):** Fee configuration not found.

Creates a new school fee invoice for the current session. **Idempotent** — if an unpaid invoice already exists for this session it is returned unchanged (no duplicate created).

Currency is set automatically: `Naira` for Nigerian students, `Dollar` for foreign students (nationality ≠ Nigeria).

If Finance has approved a staff rebate (`rebate_record.status=1`), the invoice is created at the rebated amount. If `rebated_amt` is empty, the system auto-computes the rebated total from `rebate_type` percentages in `new_fee`.

No request body needed.

**Response (201) — newly created:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Invoice generated successfully.",
  "data": {
    "invoiceno": "1234567890",
    "sessioned": "2025/2026",
    "amount_charge": 400000,
    "amount_paid": 0,
    "tuition": 50000,
    "currency": "Naira",
    "purpose": "School Fees",
    "invoice_flag": 0,
    "dateRequested": "2025-11-02",
    "dated": null,
    "student": { ... },
    "line_items": [
      { "item_id": 1, "description": "Registration-Tuition Fee", "amount": 50000 },
      { "item_id": 2, "description": "Examination Fee", "amount": 50000 }
    ],
    "payment_links": {
      "school_fees": "https://unibadanmfb.org/wallet.php?ref=1234567890&pid=18&amount=400000",
      "acceptance":  "https://unibadanmfb.org/wallet.php?ref=1234567890&pid=19",
      "application": "https://unibadanmfb.org/wallet.php?ref=1234567890&pid=21",
      "sundry":      "https://unibadanmfb.org/wallet.php?ref=1234567890&pid=20"
    }
  }
}
```

Field names are returned exactly as stored in the `reginvoice` table (`invoiceno`, `sessioned`, `dateRequested` — no renaming). `payment_links.school_fees` includes the invoice amount; the other links are base URLs.

`fee_detail2` row is created with `status: "initiated"` and `purpose: "School Fees"` (item 1 description is `Registration-Tuition Fee`).

**Response (200) — already exists:** Same shape with `message: "Invoice already generated."`

**Response (404):** Programme not found.

**Response (422):** Fee config not found or zero fees computed.

Returns the most recent invoice for the current session (paid or unpaid).

**Response (200):** Same shape as Generate Invoice response `data` — includes `invoiceno`, `sessioned`, `dateRequested` (raw column names) and `payment_links` for all four fee types.

**Response (404):** No invoice found for the current session.

item.description:
Invoice generation flow. Preview fees → Generate invoice → Pay via wallet.

For staff: verify PF number first (verify-staff) to get a rebate_preview for the Provost letter. Finance then creates rebate_record in their own admin app. preview/generate pick it up automatically.

item.name: 5. Wallet

request.description:
Creates a pending wallet_transaction and returns the UnibadanMFB deposit link.

**Body:**
```json
{
  "appno": "PGS26...",
  "amount": 50000
}
```
`amount` is required (minimum 1). A pending record is saved to `wallet_transactions` so the webhook can find and update it on payment confirmation.

**Response (200):**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "refno": "PY1746123456789",
    "amount": 50000,
    "payment_link": "https://unibadanmfb.org/wallet.php?ref=PGS26...&pid=17&amount=50000",
    "instructions": "Click the link to deposit via UnibadanMFB. Your wallet balance will update automatically once payment is confirmed."
  }
}
```

Deducts the outstanding invoice amount from the student's wallet and marks the invoice as paid.

**Body:**
```json
{
  "appno": "PGS26...",
  "invoiceno": "39305969",
  "pay_type": 1
}
```

**`pay_type` values:**
| Value | Label | Table |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | School Fee | `reginvoice` |
| 2 | Acceptance Fee | `acceptance` |
| 3 | Transcript Fee | `transinvoice` |
| 4 | Sundry Fee | `transinvoice` |

**Response (200):**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Payment successful.",
  "data": {
    "refno": "PY1730450000000",
    "invoiceno": "39305969",
    "fee_type": "School Fee",
    "amount_paid": 400000,
    "balance": 50000
  }
}
```

**Response (402) — insufficient balance:**
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "Insufficient wallet balance.",
  "data": {
    "balance": 150000,
    "outstanding": 400000,
    "shortfall": 250000
  }
}
```

**Response (404):** Invoice not found.

**Response (422):** Invoice already paid.

Returns paginated wallet transaction history.

**Response (200):**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "balance": 50000,
    "total": 3,
    "per_page": 20,
    "current_page": 1,
    "last_page": 1,
    "transactions": [
      {
        "id": 5,
        "refno": "PY1730450000000",
        "type": "fee_payment",
        "purpose": "School Fee",
        "amount": 400000,
        "status": "paid",
        "created_at": "2025-11-02 10:30:00"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

`type` values: `deposit` | `fee_payment` | `withdraw`

**Called automatically by UnibadanMFB — not by the frontend.**

The `ref` field must be the student's **numeration** (application number) — this is how the wallet is identified.

Accepted success statuses: `success`, `successful`, `paid`, `1`, `true`

Idempotent: ignores duplicate webhooks for the same amount within a 5-minute window.

**Amount validation (mandatory):** If `amount` is missing → `400`. If status is not a success value, webhook is acknowledged without crediting.

**Register this URL with UnibadanMFB (pid=17):**
`https://app.pgcollege.ui.edu.ng/regbackend/public/api/wallet/webhook`

**Test payload:**
```json
{
  "ref": "PGS26123456789",
  "status": "success",
  "amount": 400000
}
```

item.description:
Students deposit to their UI wallet via UnibadanMFB, then use it to pay their school fee invoice.

**Deposit flow:**
1. `POST /wallet/initiate-deposit` → returns UnibadanMFB payment link with `pid=17`
2. Student deposits on UnibadanMFB page
3. UnibadanMFB calls `POST /wallet/webhook` automatically — wallet is credited
4. `GET /wallet` → confirm balance
5. `POST /wallet/pay` → deduct balance and mark invoice as paid

**Webhook URL to register with UnibadanMFB:**
`{base_url_no_api}/wallet/webhook`

item.name: 6. Courses

request.description:
Returns all active courses for the student's department, degree, and specialization. Each course shows whether it has already been registered this session.

**Response (200):**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "session": "2025/2026",
  "total": 12,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "course_code": "CSC701",
      "course_title": "Advanced Algorithms",
      "unit": 3,
      "type": "Required",
      "registered": false
    }
  ]
}
```

`type` values: `Core` | `Elective` | `Required`

Saves the student's complete course selection for the current session. **Replaces** any previous selection — send the full list every time.

`course_ids` must be valid IDs from `GET /courses/available`.

**Response (200):**
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "Course selection saved." }
```

**Response (403):** Registration is locked — contact registry.

**Response (422):** No active session | invalid course IDs.

Removes a single course from the current session registration. `{courseId}` is the `course_new.id` (same as `id` from available courses list).

**Response (200):**
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "Course removed." }
```

**Response (403):** Registration is locked.

**Response (404):** Course not found in this student's registration.

Unlocks a previously locked course registration. Called by the registry on behalf of the student when they need to make changes after confirming.

No request body needed.

**Response (200):**
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "Course registration unlocked." }
```

item.description:
Course registration flow:
1. `GET /courses/available` — browse courses for dept/degree/specialization
2. `POST /courses/register` — save selection (replaces previous selection)
3. `GET /courses/registered` — review selection
4. `POST /courses/confirm` — lock registration (irreversible without registry intervention)
5. `GET /courses/print` — full printable course form data

`type` values: `Core` | `Elective` | `Required`

item.name: 7. Medical

**Required fields:** `contact_name`, `contact_telephone`, `contact_address`, `health_status`, `admitted_inpatient`, `on_medication`, `tuberculosis`, `schistosomiasis`, `respiratory_disease`, `sickle_cell_disease`, `allergies`, `diabetes`, `digestive_disease`, `heart_disease`, `genitourinary_disease`, `nervous_disease`, `family_healthy`, `family_tuberculosis`, `family_diabetes`, `family_hypertension`, `family_mental_illness`, `drug_reactions`, `immunized_hepatitis`, `immunized_tetanus`, `immunized_yellow_fever`, `immunized_meningitis`

item.name: 8. Suspension

request.description:
Returns the student's profile for pre-populating the suspension form, plus the existing suspension record if any.

`first_reg_session` comes from `biodata.yr_of_entry`; if that is null, falls back to the earliest paid `reginvoice.sessioned` for the student.

**Response (200):**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "profile": {
    "name": "Doe John Michael",
    "numeration": "PGS26...",
    "matricno": "23456",
    "faculty": "Faculty of Science",
    "department": "Computer Science",
    "degree": "M.Sc. Computer Science",
    "mode_of_study": "Full Time",
    "first_reg_session": "2024/25"
  },
  "suspension": null
}
```

`suspension` is `null` if no application has been submitted.

request.description:
Submits a new suspension application. Only one suspension record per student.

`susp_period` must be exactly `1 Semester` or `2 Semesters`.

**Response (201):**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Suspension application submitted successfully.",
  "data": {
    "id": 12,
    "numeration": "PGS26...",
    "sec": "2025/2026",
    "susp_period": "1 Semester",
    "status": "pending",
    "reactivated": false,
    ...
  }
}
```

**Response (409):** Application already exists.

Updates a pending (not yet approved) suspension application. All fields are optional — send only what changed.

**Response (200):** Updated suspension data.

**Response (403):** Application already approved — cannot be edited.

**Response (404):** No suspension application found.

item.description:
Programme suspension application. A student can only have one suspension record. Once approved it cannot be edited.

**Payment condition (enforced on submit):**
- New students (no prior paid invoice): must have paid school fees for the **current session**
- Returning students (have a prior paid invoice): must have paid school fees for the **previous session**

Submit returns 422 if the condition is not met.

item.name: 9. Reactivation

request.description:
Returns student profile and full suspension record for pre-filling the reactivation form printout.

**Requires an approved suspension** (`approved = 1`). Returns 422 if none exists.

`first_reg_session` falls back to earliest paid `reginvoice.sessioned` if `biodata.yr_of_entry` is null.

**Response (200):**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "prefill": {

    "faculty": "Faculty of Science",
    "department": "Computer Science",
    "degree": "M.Sc. Computer Science",
    "mode_of_study": "Full Time",
    "first_reg_session": "2024/25",
    "sem_completed": "2",
    "susp_period": "1 Semester",
    "resumption_session": "2026/27",
    "sponsor": "Federal Government",
    "sponsor_address": "Abuja",
    "employer": null,
    "employer_address": null
```

item.description:
Programme reactivation — for students returning from an **approved** suspension.

**Read-only GET only** — no POST. The Records Officer updates suspension/reactivation status directly via their admin tool. This endpoint returns all data needed to print and submit the reactivation form manually.

item.name: 10. Programme Extension

request.description:
Checks whether the student has exceeded their programme's maximum sessions and returns prefill data for the extension form.

**Response (200) — eligible:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "eligible": true,
  "sessions_spent": 4,
  "max_sessions": 3,
  "prefill": {
    "name": "Doe John Michael",
    "numeration": "PGS26...",
    "matricno": "23456",
    "email": "john@example.com",
    "telephone": "08012345678",
    "faculty": "Faculty of Science",
    "department": "Computer Science",
    "degree": "M.Sc. Computer Science",
    "mode_of_study": "Full Time"
  },
  "existing_application": null
}
```

`existing_application` is non-null if a previous submission exists (shows full record with `status`).

**Response (422) — not yet lapsed:**
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "message": "Your programme has not yet lapsed...",
  "sessions_spent": 2,
  "max_sessions": 3
}
```

**Response (404):** Programme information not found.

request.description:
Submits a programme extension application. Eligibility is re-checked server-side. Only one application per student.

`sec` = current academic session (e.g. `2025/26`).
`commitment` must be `Yes` or `No`.

**Response (201):**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Programme extension application submitted successfully.",
  "data": {
    "id": 1,
    "numeration": "PGS26...",
    "sec": "2025/26",
    "sessions_spent": 4,
    "max_sessions": 3,
    "reason": "Delayed due to fieldwork...",
    "commitment": "Yes",
    "status": "pending",
    "date_approved": null
  }
}
```

**Response (409):** Application already exists.

**Response (422):** Programme has not yet lapsed.

item.description:
Programme lapse and reactivation — for students who have exceeded the maximum allowed sessions for their programme.

**Maximum sessions by programme:**
| Programme | Mode | Max Sessions |
|---|---|---|
| MPhil | Any | 2 |
| Master's | Full Time | 3 |
| Master's | Part Time | 5 |
| PhD | Full Time | 5 |
| PhD | Part Time | 7 |

+1 bonus session added if the student has any previously **approved** suspension.

Sessions are counted as distinct paid `reginvoice.sessioned` values (`invoice_flag = 1`).

Only students who have reached or exceeded the effective max (base + bonus) may access and submit this form.
